newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's 9-mos tourist spending up 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's 9-mos tourist spending up 21 pct.

text.p: Foreign tourists, most of them Europeans, spent a total of 9.13 billion dirhams ($1.06 billion) in the first nine months of this year, an increase of 21.1 percent compared with the same period last year, officials said on Friday.
More than 1.2 million tourists visited Morocco in the nine months to September, up 9.2 percent from a year earlier, an official at the tourism ministry said.
The North Africans were not included in the figures, the ministry said.
French visitors represented more than 45 percent of the total, the ministry said.
